visualReview.method: Same licensed local source verified against recorded SHA-256. Early source sequence screened at 2fps; full extended encoded portrait sequence reviewed chronologically at 4fps. No transcription or generated motion.
visualReview.sequence: Extended to roughly ten seconds of the same real action at original speed: one-on-one touches, change of direction, run-up, kick at approximately 7.9 seconds, then ball travel toward the visible indoor urban astroturf court goal. Crop starts on the ball and dribbler, pans left into the run-up, holds the shooting foot at contact, and shifts right after contact for ball travel. Defender is partially cropped. Intentional hard cut back to one-on-one at loop boundary.

alternative.decision: Rejected after 2fps chronological screening: lateral action and goal less safe in narrow portrait crop. No source file retained.
